target: Standalone portable Azure Fluent-style React system; Agentweaver is first consumer/demo, not the target boundary.

artifactModel.designDoctrine: DESIGN.md core reusable system rules plus Agentweaver consumption notes

src/docs: evidence index generated from comprehensive ledger
recommendedPackageLayout.apps/demo-agentweaver: First consumer/demo app; should import system components instead of owning them.

principles: Wrap FluentProvider with a reusable AzureFluentProvider.
Expose CSS variables as semantic aliases over Fluent v9 tokens, not raw Figma dumps.
Keep density, radius, stroke, elevation, and icon slot sizes as portable classes.
Only include evidence-backed dimensions such as 264px service menu, 32px action hit targets, 18px grid resource icons, 44px horizontal tabs.

components: Generic Fluent primitive wrappers only where recipe adds Azure anatomy
componentInventoryPriority.reason: Avoid duplicating Fluent v9 without added system value.

patternInventoryPriority.status: blocked/notice-only; compose from FormBlade/StepWizard until evidence improves.

componentRecipesComplete: Resource tag editor / Tags by resource

replaceOrImport: Replace local page headers with BladeHeader.
Replace custom left nav with ServiceMenu where local/resource navigation is needed.
Replace ad hoc tables/filter bars with DataToolbar + FilterBar + AzureDataGrid + Pager.
Replace tag editing forms with ResourceTagEditor.
Replace AI/chat surfaces with CopilotComposer, CopilotResponse, InlineCopilot, AgenticProgress.
Keep app-specific routing/data fetching outside the system package.
agentweaverConsumptionPlan.demoRole: Agentweaver pages should exercise the standalone library and serve as examples, not fork component internals.

remainingBlockers: No production code should be written until package boundary/API names are approved.
83 published nodes are summary-only recipe status; they have evidence but no dedicated API recipe.
Create Resource pattern remains notice-only/unavailable in Figma evidence.
External Azure Icon for Fluent assets must be consumed through approved package/library, not copied as raw glyph catalog.
Need licensing/redistribution review before packaging any non-Fluent/Azure icon assets.
nextImplementationMilestones: Implement pattern wrappers using priority 1 components.
Migrate Agentweaver pages to consume package.

implementationStatus.packageDecision: Repo has no workspace package convention, so implementation is isolated under apps/web/src for now and structured for later extraction to packages/azure-fluent-system.
implementationStatus.iconStrategy: Uses @fluentui/react-icons plus AzureIcon/icon slots. No raw Azure/Figma glyph catalog copied. Azure resource/product icons must come from an approved Microsoft package or licensed source supplied by consumers.
implementationStatus.iconCloudAdapter: Implemented AzureIconProvider, AzureIcon registry, and createIconCloudRegistry. IconCloud is approved source, but assets not imported because unauthenticated fetch returned HTTP 401.

iconSourceHierarchy.generalSystemIcons: Use installed @fluentui/react-icons, aligned with microsoft/fluentui-system-icons package family.
iconSourceHierarchy.azureResourceProductIcons: Use IconCloud authenticated exports registered via AzureIconProvider/createIconCloudRegistry.
iconSourceHierarchy.figmaCommunity: Reference guidance only; do not scrape/copy blindly.
